scope: All 17 validation-versus-train-or-candidate flags from the original SIFT pass. Visual checks compare scene geometry, location cues and camera view. This review cannot establish global independence of every scene.

pairs.review: Open, divided highway versus a city street with a painted zebra crossing.
Dry intersection with broad white crosswalk bars versus a wet road with a right-turn arrow. Storefronts and lane markings differ.
Wide zebra crossing and red car ahead versus traffic queues, a taxi and a different storefront layout.
Overhead blue direction signs versus a vertical restriction sign beside a building facade.
Roadside Vietnamese signs versus cyclists and a dog in an open paved space.
Stop sign at sunset beside a railing versus a person and intersection in daylight.
Curved illuminated high-rise and pedestrian street versus highway flyovers photographed in daylight.
Open intersection with suspended signals versus a rain-covered residential road.
Signal on a tall pole against blue sky versus downtown traffic queues and construction.
Highway flyover and distant gantry versus a bird and a taxi in an urban intersection.
Striped crosswalk at a lit intersection versus dark road with double yellow center line and parked cars.
Wet shopping street with lights reflected off pavement versus multi-lane approach under green lights.
Similar sign/viaduct corridor, insufficient evidence of independence; candidate absent from E2 retained list.
Similar elevated-road corridor; excluded candidate absent from E2 retained list.
Different bus locations, street setting and surrounding buildings; candidate absent from E2 retained list.
Likely same elevated-road corridor, candidate excluded and absent from E2 retained list.
Bus in a depot versus a taxi on a multi-lane highway surrounded by offices.
